summary: ServiceCode is a class within HSPnet's data layer designed to manage service code information, including retrieval by course or timetable ID and localization based on session preferences.
purpose: To manage and provide access to service code information based on course or timetable criteria.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all service codes
Optionally call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID for filtered results

system_behavior: Uses specific stored procedures to retrieve service code data
Localizes service code names based on session preferences
